# University of Newcastle — Cybersecurity Posture Dashboard (Native)
**Classification: TLP:AMBER — Internal use only**

> This workbook uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Okta, Mimecast, and native Sentinel tables. No Armis connector required.
>
> **Required connectors:** MDE (`DeviceInfo`, `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities`), Okta (`Okta_CL` or `OktaSSO`), Mimecast (`CommonSecurityLog`, `MimecastSEGEvent_CL`, `MimecastSIEM_CL`, or `MimecastDLP`), Entra ID (`SigninLogs`), and standard Sentinel tables.
>
> **CISA KEV:** The Vulnerabilities tab requires a Sentinel Watchlist named `CISA-KEV` with `cveID` as the SearchKey. See the Setup tab for import instructions.

## Device Risk
> Sourced from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Requires the MDE connector and sufficient device onboarding coverage.
>
> `DeviceInfo` records update when device state changes. Use `arg_max(TimeGenerated, *)` to get the current state per device. Devices that have not reported in the time window will not appear — extend the time range or use `ago(7d)` in a custom query if you need full inventory.

content.query:
// MDE device exposure level distribution - current state
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| extend ExposureLevel = column_ifexists("ExposureLevel", "Unknown")
| summarize DeviceCount = count() by ExposureLevel
| sort by
    case(
        ExposureLevel == "VeryHigh", 1,
        ExposureLevel == "High",     2,
        ExposureLevel == "Medium",   3,
        ExposureLevel == "Low",      4,
        5
    )
content.title: Devices by Risk Score (MDE)
Onboarding Coverage

content.query:
// Device count by OS platform
union isfuzzy=true DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize Count=count() by OSPlatform
| sort by Count desc
content.title: Devices by OS Platform

content.query:
// High-risk devices triage list (Defender-aligned)
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| extend
    ExposureLevel = column_ifexists("ExposureLevel", "Unknown"),
    RiskScore     = column_ifexists("RiskScore", "Unknown"),
    SensorHealth  = column_ifexists("SensorHealthState", "Unknown")
| where
    ExposureLevel in ("High", "VeryHigh")
    or RiskScore in ("High", "Critical")
| project
    DeviceName,
    ExposureLevel,
    RiskScore,
    SensorHealth,
    OSPlatform,
    OSVersion,
    OnboardingStatus,
    LastSeen = TimeGenerated
| sort by
    ExposureLevel desc,
    SensorHealth asc,
    LastSeen asc
| take 30
content.title: High / Critical Risk Devices

| extend RiskScore    = column_ifexists('RiskScore', 'Unknown')

content.json:
## Vulnerabilities & CISA KEV Coverage
> **⚠️ MDE Plan 1 environment:** `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` requires MDE Plan 2. TVM panels below will populate once Plan 2 is licensed or ARMIS is connected. See **Setup → Step 1b** to confirm.
>
> **What works now:** The **Active Exploit Detections** section at the bottom of this tab extracts CVE IDs directly from `SecurityAlert` — these are vulnerabilities being actively exploited against estate devices, which is more operationally urgent than a passive inventory.
>
> **VIB Q1 2026 priority CVEs** (Section 3.1 — check the first grid below for these specifically):
> Cisco Firewall CVE-2026-20131 (CVSS 10.0, Interlock ransomware) · BeyondTrust CVE-2026-1731 (9.9) · Ivanti EPMM CVE-2026-1281/1340 (9.8, MDM) · Fortinet CVE-2026-24858 (9.4) · n8n CVE-2026-21858 (10.0) · Oracle EBS CVE-2025-61882 (Cl0p/FIN11 campaign) · MongoDB CVE-2025-14847 (active AU exploitation)
>
> CVE data sourced from MDE Threat & Vulnerability Management (`DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities`) in **Log Analytics**. Panels use the latest record per device+CVE (90-day lookback), not only rows in the workbook time range.
>
> **MDE portal vs Sentinel:** If **all** TVM panels including Total Open CVEs are 0, TVM may not be in this Log Analytics workspace — run **Setup → Step 1b**.

content.query:
// MDE exposure summary — unfiltered totals (compare to KEV / VIB panels below)
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm;
let KEV = _GetWatchlist('CISA-KEV')
| extend cveID = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(column_ifexists('cveID', column_ifexists('CVE', tostring(SearchKey))))))
| where cveID startswith 'CVE-'
| distinct cveID;
TVM
| summarize
    ['Distinct CVEs'] = dcount(CveIdNorm),
    ['Device-CVE pairs'] = count(),
    Devices = dcount(DeviceId),
    Critical = dcountif(CveIdNorm, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Critical'),
    High = dcountif(CveIdNorm, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'High'),
    ['KEV CVEs in estate'] = dcountif(CveIdNorm, CveIdNorm in (KEV | project cveID)),
    ['Latest TVM record'] = max(TimeGenerated)
content.title: MDE TVM Exposure Summary (all CVEs)

content.query:
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let PriorityCVEs = dynamic([
    "CVE-2026-20131",
    "CVE-2026-1731",
    "CVE-2026-1281",
    "CVE-2026-1340",
    "CVE-2026-24858",
    "CVE-2026-21858",
    "CVE-2025-61882",
    "CVE-2025-14847"
]);
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm;
TVM
| where CveIdNorm in (PriorityCVEs)
| project CveId = CveIdNorm, SoftwareName, SoftwareVendor, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, DeviceName, LastSeen = TimeGenerated
| sort by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc
content.title: VIB Q1 2026 Priority CVE Exposure (empty = not in estate)

content.query:
// Devices matching CISA KEV entries — latest TVM state joined to watchlist (normalized CVE IDs)
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let KEV = _GetWatchlist('CISA-KEV')
| extend cveID = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(column_ifexists('cveID', column_ifexists('CVE', tostring(SearchKey))))))
| where cveID startswith 'CVE-'
| project cveID,
          vendorProject   = column_ifexists('vendorProject', ''),
          product         = column_ifexists('product', ''),
          dateAdded       = column_ifexists('dateAdded', ''),
          dueDate         = column_ifexists('dueDate', ''),
          knownRansomware = column_ifexists('knownRansomwareCampaignUse', '');
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm;
TVM
| join kind=inner KEV on $left.CveIdNorm == $right.cveID
| extend RansomwareFlag = iff(knownRansomware == "Known", "Ransomware", "")
| extend DaysUntilDue   = iff(isnotempty(dueDate), datetime_diff('day', todatetime(dueDate), now()), int(null))
| project CveId = CveIdNorm, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, DeviceName, dateAdded, dueDate, DaysUntilDue, RansomwareFlag, LastSeen = TimeGenerated
| sort by DaysUntilDue asc
content.title: Devices Matching CISA KEV Entries
KEV Exposure by Vendor
Devices by CVE Severity (MDE TVM)

content.query:
// Most vulnerable devices — ranked by critical CVE count (latest state)
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm;
TVM
| summarize
    TotalCVEs    = dcount(CveIdNorm),
    CriticalCVEs = dcountif(CveIdNorm, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Critical"),
    HighCVEs     = dcountif(CveIdNorm, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "High")
  by DeviceName
| sort by CriticalCVEs desc, HighCVEs desc
| take 25

content.query:
// KEV dwell time — days since each matched CVE was added to CISA KEV list
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let KEV = _GetWatchlist('CISA-KEV')
| extend cveID = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(column_ifexists('cveID', column_ifexists('CVE', tostring(SearchKey))))))
| where cveID startswith 'CVE-'
| project cveID,
          vendorProject = column_ifexists('vendorProject', 'Unknown'),
          dateAdded     = column_ifexists('dateAdded', '');
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm;

| extend DwellDays = iff(isnotempty(dateAdded), datetime_diff('day', now(), todatetime(dateAdded)), int(null))
| summarize DwellDays = max(DwellDays), AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceId) by CveId = CveIdNorm, vendorProject

### Native Defender Vulnerability Findings
> The queries below draw directly from `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` with no watchlist dependency. Use these to understand raw exposure in the estate — highest-impact CVEs to remediate, software with the most open vulnerabilities, and where public exploits exist.

content.query:
// Top Critical/High CVEs by device exposure (latest state, no watchlist)
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend
    CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId))),
    IsExploit = column_ifexists("IsExploitAvailable", 0),
    CveTagsStr = tostring(column_ifexists("CveTags", dynamic([])))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm;
TVM
| where VulnerabilitySeverityLevel in ("Critical", "High")
| summarize
    ['Affected Devices'] = dcount(DeviceId),
    Severity = any(VulnerabilitySeverityLevel),
    ['Public Exploit'] = iff(max(IsExploit) == 1 or max(CveTagsStr has "Exploit"), "Yes", ""),
    Software = any(SoftwareName),
    Vendor = any(SoftwareVendor)
  by CveId = CveIdNorm
| extend SeverityOrder = case(Severity == "Critical", 2, Severity == "High", 1, 0)
| sort by ['Affected Devices'] desc, SeverityOrder desc
| project-away SeverityOrder
| take 25
content.title: Top Critical/High CVEs by Device Exposure (no watchlist)

content.query:
// Software packages with the most distinct Critical/High CVEs (latest state)
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm, SoftwareName, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareVersion;
TVM
| where VulnerabilitySeverityLevel in ("Critical", "High")
| summarize
    DistinctCVEs    = dcount(CveIdNorm),
    AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceId),
    CriticalCount   = dcountif(CveIdNorm, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Critical"),
    HighCount       = dcountif(CveIdNorm, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "High")
  by SoftwareName, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareVersion
| sort by DistinctCVEs desc
| take 20
| project Software=SoftwareName, Vendor=SoftwareVendor, Version=SoftwareVersion,
    ['Total CVEs']=DistinctCVEs, Critical=CriticalCount, High=HighCount, ['Devices Affected']=AffectedDevices
content.title: Software with Most Open Vulnerabilities

content.query:
// CVEs with confirmed public exploits (latest state)
let TVMLookback = 90d;
let TVM = union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TVMLookback)
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| extend
    CveIdNorm = toupper(trim(" ", tostring(CveId))),
    IsExploit = column_ifexists("IsExploitAvailable", 0),
    CveTagsStr = tostring(column_ifexists("CveTags", dynamic([])))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, CveIdNorm;
TVM
| where IsExploit == 1 or CveTagsStr has "Exploit"
| summarize
    ['Affected Devices'] = dcount(DeviceId),
    Severity = any(VulnerabilitySeverityLevel),
    Software = any(SoftwareName),
    Vendor = any(SoftwareVendor)
  by CveId = CveIdNorm
| extend SeverityOrder = case(Severity == "Critical", 4, Severity == "High", 3, Severity == "Medium", 2, Severity == "Low", 1, 0)
| sort by SeverityOrder desc, ['Affected Devices'] desc
| project-away SeverityOrder
| project CveId, Severity, Software, Vendor, ['Affected Devices']
content.title: CVEs with Public Exploits Available

content.json:
## Identity Risk
> Draws from Entra ID (`SigninLogs`) and Okta (`Okta_CL` / `OktaSSO`). Risky sign-in data requires Entra ID Identity Protection (P2 licence). Okta queries use `union isfuzzy=true` to handle both legacy DCR connector and the newer CCP connector table names.
>
> If Okta tiles show 0, run the **Setup & Validation** tab to confirm your table name.

content.title: Risky Sign-ins (Entra)
Failed MFA Attempts

content.query:
// Okta authentication failures and policy events
union isfuzzy=true
    (Okta_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('outcome_result_s', '')
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('eventType_s', '')
     | where Outcome =~ "FAILURE"
        or EventType has_any ('mfa', 'policy', 'admin', 'lock')),
    (OktaSSO
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('Outcome_Result', '')
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('EventType', '')
     | where Outcome =~ "FAILURE"
        or EventType has_any ('mfa', 'policy', 'admin', 'lock'))
| summarize ['Okta Auth Failures / Policy Events']=count()
content.title: Okta Failures / Policy Events
Accounts with Risky Sign-ins

content.query:
// Sign-in failure reasons breakdown
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Count=count() by ResultDescription
| sort by Count desc
| take 10
content.title: Sign-in Failure Reasons

content.query:
// Risky sign-ins by country of origin
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
| summarize Count=count() by Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| sort by Count desc
| take 15
content.title: Risky Sign-ins by Country

content.query:
// Risky sign-ins detail — prioritised by risk level
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, ResultType, ResultDescription
| sort by RiskLevelDuringSignIn asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Risky Sign-ins Detail

content.query:
// Okta events - failures, MFA events, admin access, lockouts
union isfuzzy=true
    (Okta_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('eventType_s', '')
     | extend Actor     = column_ifexists('actor_alternateId_s', '')
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('outcome_result_s', '')
     | extend Message   = column_ifexists('displayMessage_s', '')
     | extend Severity  = column_ifexists('severity_s', '')),
    (OktaSSO
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('EventType', '')
     | extend Actor     = column_ifexists('Actor_AlternateId', '')
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('Outcome_Result', '')
     | extend Message   = column_ifexists('DisplayMessage', '')
     | extend Severity  = column_ifexists('Severity', ''))
| where Outcome =~ "FAILURE"
   or EventType has_any ('mfa', 'policy', 'admin', 'lock', 'access_admin')
| project TimeGenerated, EventType, Actor, Outcome, Message, Severity
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Okta Failure / Policy Events
Credential Reset → Immediate Login (ShinyHunters Pattern — VIB Section 5.2)

content.query:
// AiTM (Adversary-in-the-Middle) phishing indicators
// VIB Q1 2026 Section 5.3: REN-ISAC advisory — AiTM defeats traditional MFA by proxying sessions
// Indicators: successful MFA auth from unregistered/non-compliant device, high-risk state
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == "0"
| where AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication"
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
    or RiskState has_any ("atRisk", "confirmedCompromised")
| extend DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId)
| extend IsCompliant = tostring(DeviceDetail.isCompliant)
| extend DeviceName = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, DeviceName, IsCompliant, AppDisplayName
| sort by RiskLevelDuringSignIn asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: AiTM Phishing Indicators — MFA Bypass Risk (VIB Section 5.3)

## Alerts & Incidents
Draws from `SecurityAlert` and `SecurityIncident` — standard Sentinel tables that populate from all connected sources (MDE, Defender for O365, Okta, Mimecast, Sentinel analytics rules).

content.title: Incidents by Severity & Status
Alerts by Source

content.query:
// Open incidents — deduplicated to current status

---
### Notes

**Okta table names** depend on the connector version:
- Legacy DCR: `Okta_CL` — column names use `camelCase_s` suffix
- CCP (newer): `OktaSSO` — column names are clean (no suffix)

All Identity tab queries use `union isfuzzy=true` to handle both. If you see unexpected nulls, check which table is active from Step 2 above and verify the column names with `getschema Okta_CL`.

**Mimecast table names** depend on the connector:
- Via CEF/Syslog: `CommonSecurityLog | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"`
- Via Mimecast SEG API connector: `MimecastSEGEvent_CL` or `MimecastSIEM_CL`
- Via Mimecast solution DLP/TTP: `MimecastDLP` (columns may include `Action`, `Recipient Address` with spaces)
- Mimecast actions are often `Held` / `hold`, not `Hold` — the Email tab normalises action values to lowercase
- Run **Step 3c** if the bottom Mimecast grid is empty: check `DistinctActions` and `RecipientsPopulated`

**Entra ID risk data** (`RiskLevelDuringSignIn`) requires Azure AD Identity Protection P2 licence. Without it the column exists but all values are `none`.

**DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities** uses a 90-day lookback and `arg_max` per device+CVE (current posture, not workbook time range only). TVM may lag MDE portal by up to 24 hours.

**Weekly CVE / KEV trend metrics:** For each calendar week, TVM rows are grouped by `startofweek(TimeGenerated)`. Within each week, `arg_max(TimeGenerated, *)` is taken per `DeviceId` + normalized `CveId` — the latest snapshot for that device+CVE in that week. Weekly counts are `dcount` of distinct CVE IDs (or KEV-filtered CVE IDs) after that snapshot. This is an end-of-week posture snapshot, not cumulative new CVEs discovered in the week.

**Zero vs non-zero:** Overview **Total Open CVEs** > 0 but **KEV Matches** = 0 means no overlap with the `CISA-KEV` watchlist (run Step 1c). **VIB Priority CVEs** = 0 often means none of the fixed CVE-2026-* IDs exist in your estate — expected for many tenants.

**KEV watchlist:** SearchKey must be `cveID` (or use a `cveID` column); workbook normalises IDs to uppercase before join.

### Active Exploit Detections (Plan 1 Compatible)
> **Source:** `SecurityAlert` from Microsoft Defender ATP. CVE IDs are extracted from alert descriptions using regex — no TVM or Plan 2 licence required.
>
> Rows here represent CVEs **being actively exploited** against estate devices right now. This is more operationally urgent than a passive vulnerability inventory. Empty = no CVE-tagged alerts in the selected time range (good).

content.query:
// Extract CVE IDs from MDE alert descriptions — Plan 1 compatible
union isfuzzy=true SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ProviderName =~ "Microsoft Defender Advanced Threat Protection"
| extend CVEs = extract_all(@"(CVE-\d{4}-\d{4,})", Description)
| where array_length(CVEs) > 0
| mv-expand CVE = CVEs
| summarize
    AlertCount      = count(),
    AffectedDevices = dcount(CompromisedEntity),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated),
    Severity        = any(AlertSeverity),
    SampleAlert     = any(AlertName)
  by tostring(CVE)
| extend SevOrder = case(Severity=="Critical",4,Severity=="High",3,Severity=="Medium",2,1)
| sort by SevOrder desc, AlertCount desc
| project-away SevOrder
| take 30
content.title: Active Exploit Detections — CVEs in MDE Alerts

content.query:
// Quarter-over-quarter KPI comparison — auto-calculates current vs previous quarter
let now_ = now();
let TQ   = datetime_add('month', -((monthofyear(now_) - 1) % 3), startofmonth(now_));
let LQ   = datetime_add('month', -3, TQ);
// Anchor all sub-queries at 180d so the workbook time-range picker
// cannot silently cut off last quarter's data
let _anchor = ago(180d);
// Alerts
let a1 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where TimeGenerated >= TQ
    | where AlertSeverity in ("Critical","High")
    | count);
let a2 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where TimeGenerated >= LQ and TimeGenerated < TQ
    | where AlertSeverity in ("Critical","High")
    | count);
// P1/P2 Incidents
let i1 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime,*) by IncidentNumber
    | where CreatedTime >= TQ
    | where Severity in ("High","Medium")
    | count);
let i2 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime,*) by IncidentNumber
    | where CreatedTime >= LQ and CreatedTime < TQ
    | where Severity in ("High","Medium")
    | count);
// MTTR — avg returns NaN on empty input, handle with isnull/isnan
let m1 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where ClosedTime >= TQ
    | where Status in ("Closed","Resolved")
    | extend H = datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0
    | summarize AvgH = avg(H)
    | project iif(isnan(AvgH) or isnull(AvgH), 0.0, round(AvgH, 1)));
let m2 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where ClosedTime >= LQ and ClosedTime < TQ
    | where Status in ("Closed","Resolved")
    | extend H = datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0
    | summarize AvgH = avg(H)
    | project iif(isnan(AvgH) or isnull(AvgH), 0.0, round(AvgH, 1)));
// Risky sign-ins
let r1 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where TimeGenerated >= TQ
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
    | count);
let r2 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where TimeGenerated >= LQ and TimeGenerated < TQ
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
    | count);
// Blocked email (all Mimecast sources + Defender)
let e1 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
    (EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor | where TimeGenerated >= TQ | where DeliveryAction in ("Blocked","Replaced")),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor | where TimeGenerated >= TQ | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"
     | where tolower(tostring(DeviceAction)) has_any ("block","reject","hold","held","prevent","quarantine","bounce")),
    (MimecastSEGEvent_CL | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor | where TimeGenerated >= TQ
     | where tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('action_s',column_ifexists('Action','')))) has_any ("block","reject","hold","held","prevent","quarantine","bounce"))
    | count);
let e2 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
    (EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor | where TimeGenerated >= LQ and TimeGenerated < TQ | where DeliveryAction in ("Blocked","Replaced")),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor | where TimeGenerated >= LQ and TimeGenerated < TQ | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"
     | where tolower(tostring(DeviceAction)) has_any ("block","reject","hold","held","prevent","quarantine","bounce")),
    (MimecastSEGEvent_CL | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor | where TimeGenerated >= LQ and TimeGenerated < TQ
     | where tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('action_s',column_ifexists('Action','')))) has_any ("block","reject","hold","held","prevent","quarantine","bounce"))
    | count);
// Device onboarding %
let d1 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where TimeGenerated >= TQ
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by DeviceId
    | summarize Total=count(), Onboarded=countif(OnboardingStatus=="Onboarded")
    | project iif(Total==0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Onboarded / Total, 1)));
let d2 = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated >= _anchor
    | where TimeGenerated >= LQ and TimeGenerated < TQ
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by DeviceId
    | summarize Total=count(), Onboarded=countif(OnboardingStatus=="Onboarded")
    | project iif(Total==0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Onboarded / Total, 1)));
let _metrics = dynamic(["Critical / High Alerts","P1 / P2 Incidents","Avg MTTR","Risky Sign-ins","Blocked Email Threats","Device Onboarding"]);
let _units   = dynamic(["","","hrs","","","%"]);
let _dirs    = dynamic(["Down","Down","Down","Down","Down","Up"]);
let _thisq   = pack_array(todouble(a1),todouble(i1),todouble(m1),todouble(r1),todouble(e1),todouble(d1));
let _lastq   = pack_array(todouble(a2),todouble(i2),todouble(m2),todouble(r2),todouble(e2),todouble(d2));
range idx from 0 to 5 step 1
| extend Metric  = tostring(_metrics[idx])
| extend Unit    = tostring(_units[idx])
| extend GoodDir = tostring(_dirs[idx])
| extend ThisQ   = toreal(_thisq[idx])
| extend LastQ   = toreal(_lastq[idx])
| project-away idx
| extend Delta = ThisQ - LastQ
| extend Trend = case(
    GoodDir == "Down" and Delta < 0, "✅ Improving",
    GoodDir == "Down" and Delta > 0, "🔴 Worsening",
    GoodDir == "Up"   and Delta > 0, "✅ Improving",
    GoodDir == "Up"   and Delta < 0, "🔴 Worsening",
    "➡️ No change")
| extend ['This Quarter'] = iff(Unit == "", tostring(toint(ThisQ)), strcat(tostring(ThisQ), " ", Unit))
| extend ['Last Quarter'] = iff(Unit == "", tostring(toint(LastQ)), strcat(tostring(LastQ), " ", Unit))
| extend ['Change'] = iff(Delta >= 0, strcat("+", tostring(round(Delta,1))), tostring(round(Delta,1)))
| project Metric, ['This Quarter'], ['Last Quarter'], ['Change'], Trend

let Lookback = 90d;
SecurityIncident
| where isnotempty(IncidentNumber) and isnotempty(CreatedTime)
| where CreatedTime >= ago(Lookback)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend
    TTT_hours = iff(isnotnull(CreatedTime) and isnotnull(FirstModifiedTime),
                    datetime_diff('minute', FirstModifiedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0, real(null)),
    TTC_hours = iff(isnotnull(CreatedTime) and isnotnull(ClosedTime),

    TTD_hours = iff(isnotnull(FirstActivityTime) and isnotnull(CreatedTime),

| summarize
    TotalIncidents        = dcount(IncidentNumber),

    ['Medium 🟡']         = countif(Severity == 'Medium'),
    ['Low 🟢']            = countif(Severity == 'Low'),

    ['MTTT/H (P50 hrs)']  = round(percentile(TTT_hours, 50), 1),

    ['MTTD (P50 hrs)']    = round(percentile(TTD_hours, 50), 1),
